chapters.title: Hannah's prayer
chapters.summary: Hannah, childless and taunted, pours out her heart to God at Shiloh and vows to give Him a son. God remembers her, and she gives birth to Samuel and dedicates him.

chapters.title: Hannah's song and Eli's sons
chapters.summary: Hannah praises God who raises the poor from the dust. Young Samuel serves at Shiloh, while Eli's sons abuse the priesthood and a prophet foretells judgment on Eli's house.

chapters.title: Speak, Lord
chapters.summary: God calls the boy Samuel in the night. Taught by Eli, Samuel answers, "Speak; for thy servant heareth," and receives a message of judgment on Eli's family.

chapters.title: The ark captured
chapters.summary: Israel takes the ark into battle like a charm and is defeated by the Philistines. The ark is captured, Eli's sons are killed, and Eli dies at the news.

chapters.title: The ark among the Philistines
chapters.summary: In Dagon's temple, the idol falls before the ark. Plagues strike each Philistine city that keeps it.

chapters.title: The ark returned
chapters.summary: The Philistines send the ark back on a cart pulled by two cows, which head straight for Israel. The people of Beth-shemesh rejoice, but treat it carelessly.

chapters.title: Ebenezer
chapters.summary: Samuel calls Israel to put away foreign gods. When the Philistines attack, God thunders against them, and Samuel sets up a stone: hitherto hath the Lord helped us.

chapters.title: Israel asks for a king
chapters.summary: Samuel's sons are corrupt, so the elders ask for a king like the nations. God tells Samuel they have rejected Him, and Samuel warns what a king will take.

chapters.title: Saul meets Samuel
chapters.summary: Searching for his father's donkeys, Saul, a tall Benjamite, comes to Samuel, whom God has told to anoint him as leader.

chapters.title: Saul anointed king
chapters.summary: Samuel anoints Saul in private. God gives Saul a new heart, and he is chosen by lot at Mizpah, though he hides among the baggage.

chapters.title: Saul rescues Jabesh
chapters.summary: When the Ammonites threaten Jabesh-gilead, the Spirit of God comes on Saul. He rallies Israel, wins, and the kingdom is renewed at Gilgal.

chapters.title: Samuel's farewell
chapters.summary: Samuel defends his honest leadership, recounts God's faithfulness, and warns Israel and their king to serve the Lord. He promises to keep praying for them.

chapters.title: Saul's impatience
chapters.summary: With the Philistines massing, Saul offers the sacrifice himself instead of waiting for Samuel. Samuel says his kingdom will not last and God seeks a man after His own heart.

chapters.title: Jonathan's bold attack
chapters.summary: Jonathan and his armor-bearer attack a Philistine outpost, trusting that God can save by many or by few. Panic spreads, but Saul's rash oath nearly costs Jonathan his life.

chapters.title: Saul rejected
chapters.summary: Saul spares King Agag and the best of the Amalekite spoil against God's command. Samuel tells him that to obey is better than sacrifice, and God rejects him as king.

chapters.title: David anointed
chapters.summary: Samuel anoints David, the youngest son of Jesse, for the Lord looks on the heart. David's harp music soothes the troubled Saul.

chapters.title: David and Goliath
chapters.summary: Goliath defies Israel's army for forty days. Young David faces him with a sling and five stones in the name of the Lord, and kills him.

chapters.title: Jonathan's friendship, Saul's jealousy
chapters.summary: Jonathan loves David as himself and makes a covenant with him. As the women sing of David's victories, Saul grows jealous and afraid of him.

chapters.title: Saul tries to kill David
chapters.summary: Jonathan defends David, but Saul throws a spear at him. Michal helps David escape, and Saul's men are overcome by the Spirit at Ramah.

chapters.title: Jonathan warns David
chapters.summary: Jonathan tests his father's intentions and warns David with arrows in a field. The friends weep and part in peace.

chapters.title: David at Nob and Gath
chapters.summary: Fleeing, David is given holy bread and Goliath's sword by the priest at Nob. In Gath he pretends to be mad to escape.

chapters.title: The cave of Adullam
chapters.summary: Discontented men gather to David. Saul has the priests of Nob massacred for helping him, and only Abiathar escapes to David.

chapters.title: David in the wilderness
chapters.summary: David rescues the town of Keilah and keeps fleeing Saul. Jonathan finds him and strengthens his hand in God.

chapters.title: David spares Saul
chapters.summary: In a cave at En-gedi, David cuts off a corner of Saul's robe but will not harm the Lord's anointed. Saul weeps and admits David is more righteous.

chapters.title: Nabal and Abigail
chapters.summary: Samuel dies. Rich Nabal insults David, and David sets out for revenge until wise Abigail meets him with gifts and turns him back. Nabal dies, and David marries Abigail.

chapters.title: David spares Saul again
chapters.summary: David and Abishai slip into Saul's camp at night and take his spear and water jug, but David again refuses to strike the Lord's anointed.

chapters.title: David among the Philistines
chapters.summary: Despairing of escaping Saul, David settles with the Philistine king Achish in Ziklag and raids Israel's enemies while deceiving Achish.

chapters.title: Saul and the medium
chapters.summary: Facing the Philistines and hearing nothing from God, Saul consults a medium at En-dor. Samuel appears and foretells Saul's death.

chapters.title: David sent back
chapters.summary: The Philistine commanders distrust David and refuse to let him fight against Israel, so Achish sends him home.

chapters.title: David strengthens himself in God
chapters.summary: Raiders burn Ziklag and take the families. In deep distress David finds strength in God, pursues them, recovers everything, and shares the spoil fairly.

chapters.title: The death of Saul
chapters.summary: The Philistines defeat Israel on Mount Gilboa. Saul's sons, including Jonathan, are killed, and Saul falls on his own sword.
